title: Sunken Solarium - Drowned Halls
_note: Option B mood sibling, more melancholy / Tide-forward. gbc 4-voice band. emotional. G major slipping toward its relative E minor, 88 BPM, 4/4, 24 bars. Slower, more spacious lead with more rests; sinking phrases that don't always climb back. Arp slowed and submerged — a watery rolling figure, lower register, Tide-cool against the Solar warmth. Deeper bass with a gentle swelling pulse like a slow tide. Minimal drums — a soft low thud and occasional droplet-tick hat. Vesper motif in relative minor: rising contour D4->G4->A4 now wistful, the settle B4->A4->G4 lands lower than home (resolving to E, a third short of comfort). Last bar E->D->G pickup voice-leads to bar 1.
